import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.Sheaf
import Mathlib.Topology.Sheaves.SheafCondition.Sites

/-!
# Detecting module isomorphisms on a basis

A morphism of structure-sheaf modules is an isomorphism when its section maps
are isomorphisms on a basis of opens. This is the underlying abelian-sheaf
basis criterion, with the scalar action retained in its hypothesis.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Opposite TopologicalSpace

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules

/-- Section maps on an open basis detect isomorphisms of structure-sheaf modules. -/
theorem isIso_of_isIso_app_basis {X : Scheme.{u}} {M N : X.Modules}
    (φ : M ⟶ N) {ι : Type*} (B : ι → X.Opens)
    (hB : Opens.IsBasis (Set.range B))
    (hφ : ∀ i, IsIso (φ.val.app (op (B i)))) : IsIso φ := by
  haveI : IsIso ((toPresheaf X).map φ) := by
    let F : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} X.toTopCat := ⟨M.presheaf, M.isSheaf⟩
    let G : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} X.toTopCat := ⟨N.presheaf, N.isSheaf⟩
    let ψ : F ⟶ G := ⟨(toPresheaf X).map φ⟩
    haveI : IsIso ψ := by
      apply TopCat.Sheaf.isIso_iff_isIso_basis hB
      intro i
      change IsIso ((forget₂ (ModuleCat Γ(X, B i)) AddCommGrpCat).map
        (φ.val.app (op (B i))))
      exact @Functor.map_isIso _ _ _ _ _ _
        (forget₂ (ModuleCat Γ(X, B i)) AddCommGrpCat)
        (φ.val.app (op (B i))) (hφ i)
    exact Functor.map_isIso (TopCat.Sheaf.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u} X.toTopCat) ψ
  exact isIso_of_reflects_iso φ (toPresheaf X)

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules
